Customer request: My name is Ivan Nowak. Serial 98148469. The protective goggles were missing from my box. Everything else arrived. Please send the goggles.

Approved customer-disclosable manual sections:
[PROC-GEN-MISSING-ACCESSORY | QMS-DOC-0111 v1.2 | ALL Rev ALL | section: Scope and applicability]
This procedure applies to every model in the range when a customer reports
that an item expected with their delivery was not in the box: goggles, a mains
cord, a filter, a spare lamp or the instructions for use.

It is a customer-service and logistics procedure, not a device-fault
procedure. It covers establishing what is actually missing and raising the
right product movement. It does not cover any fault with the device itself.

[PROC-GEN-MISSING-ACCESSORY | QMS-DOC-0111 v1.2 | ALL Rev ALL | section: Symptom confirmation]
Ask the customer to confirm which items they have received, not only which
they believe are missing. Packing varies and accessories are often in a
separate compartment under the moulded insert rather than loose in the carton.

Ask them to check that compartment before anything is shipped, and ask for the
part name as printed on the carton label where one is visible.

Customer request: My name is Ivan Nowak. Serial 98148469. My P4800 is completely dead: no lights, no fan and no display. What can I check without opening it?
Already received observations: {"all_lamps_affected": false, "power_on": false}. Do not ask the customer to provide an observation already received. Focus on the next unknown.

Approved customer-disclosable manual sections:
[PROC-P4800-PWR-A | QMS-DOC-0101 v3.0 | P4800 Rev A | section: Scope and applicability]
This procedure applies to the P4800 benchtop phototherapy unit, hardware revision A
only. Revision A units are identified by an ERP install date earlier than 1 January
2022 and carry a grey rear chassis plate with a single captive mains inlet. Do not
apply this procedure to revision B or revision C units; the rear panel interlock
wiring differs and the checks below will give misleading results.

Use this procedure when the customer reports that the unit shows no signs of power:
no status LED, no fan noise, and no display backlight when the mains switch is set
to the on position.

[PROC-MANUAL-P4800 | QMS-DOC-0203 v1.0 | P4800 Rev A/B/C | section: Scope and prerequisites]
This independently fictional user manual covers ordinary customer observations for P4800 revisions A, B and C. These exterior checks are authorized across all supported variants; they do not authorize a repair or revision-specific service procedure. Establish the model from the label or the fictional equipment record. Account verification is not required for these public instructions.

[PROC-MANUAL-P4800 | QMS-DOC-0203 v1.0 | P4800 Rev A/B/C | section: Safety before operation]
Stop using the device if smoke, an unusual burning smell, sparking, excessive heat or an injury is reported. Disconnect the unit if safe and contact support. Do not open the enclosure, remove a cover, bypass an interlock or change prescribed treatment settings.

[PROC-MANUAL-P4800 | QMS-DOC-0203 v1.0 | P4800 Rev A/B/C | section: Basic power-on observations]
With the unit idle and no safety concern present, confirm whether the accessible power lead is connected and whether the normal power indicator illuminates. Observe the display and treatment indicator. If the display remains dark, record that observation and contact support for the exact equipment procedure; do not replace fuses or investigate internal wiring.
Compose the next helpful reply without printing source identifiers.
